candidates.name: Restriction lemma: clause-count-free expansion of a p-restricted width-k CNF into width-b CNF tests with E W <= 1/(1-theta), valid for ANY constant pk (b = b(pk))
paper_items: I15 backward averaging count F_s(R) <= theta^s (02:235-342)
bookkeeping I08 easy/hard counts, I10 paths, I13 path weights, I14 reweighting
candidates.trace: no reasoning trace exists for family 112
candidates.statement: For H width <= k on [d], b >= 1, theta = sum_{l=b+1}^k C(k,l)(2p/(1-p))^l < 1: exists W(H,T,rho) >= 0 with E W <= 1/(1-theta) and |E_z G H_{T,rho}| <= W corr_b(G) for all G simultaneously. Proof: H_{T,rho} = K + K sum_j (-1)^j sum_{paths} prod v_{i_h}/prod a_{U_h}; each term = omega(P) E[J_P] (marker mixture); count paths backwards from the terminal live set with weight 1/|V_R| averaging over eligible violated clauses.

Neither the goal nor any statement in L (H89, HJP95, PPZ99, PPSZ05, PSZ00, IPZ01, DHMTW14, Mathlib) contains a signed expansion of H_{T,rho} into narrow CNFs with an L1 cost, nor the quantities a_U, c_U, 1/|V_R|. final.justification: No neighbour found in four searches over the switching-lemma family (Hastad, Razborov, Rossman, SBI, Lovett-Wu-Zhang, GMR, IMP12); the conclusion (clause-count-free L1 expansion into narrow CNFs at arbitrary constant pk) differs from all of them; non-analytic; the knockout shows it is the step that breaks the sqrt n ceiling. Not templated (the IH F_s(R) <= theta^s is incidental). Confidence held at 0.5 because the switching-lemma neighbourhood is dense and expert-heavy, zbMATH/MathOverflow were not queried, and the whole result is extraordinary and unreviewed (Lean-formalized but not built here).

family_D.rests_on: C1 alone (restriction lemma cluster I07 + I11 + I15, with C2 marker mixture as a sub-device). All other candidates are N0-N2.
family_D.falls_to: D2 if (a) an expert identifies a known clause-count-free narrow-CNF expansion valid at arbitrary constant pk (most likely places: Razborov/Hastad switching-lemma variants for proof complexity, Lovett-Wu-Zhang follow-ups, Tal/Rossman AC0 correlation work, IMP12-style SAT-algorithm decompositions), or (b) Test 4 directed arm exceeds the calibrated threshold.
family_D.not_transfer: C1 is a home-field (TCS) tool with no cross-field import; the cross-field imports (sunflowers, finite fields) sit in N0 items.
family_D.correctness_caveat: Grades assume correctness. family.md re-derived the restriction lemma and parameter arithmetic and found no gap; Lean proves the comparator end to end (no sorry/axiom), but was not compiled here. The result would break a decades-old barrier, so external verification matters.
family_D.compression_note: C1 is a single-use bottleneck lemma between the pseudorandom slice and the counting step, but it is also a reusable tool (any function pseudorandom against narrow CNFs on restrictions inherits width-sqrt(n) bounds). Downstream speedup targets: depth-3 bounds for other pseudorandom families, AC0 correlation bounds at depth 3, Res(k)/depth-2 Frege where clause-count-free width reduction is useful.
